author: Mark Atwood
text: Independent corroboration from security review pass (worker4, 2026-09-08 session): re-derived the same mismatch bottom-up. lichen_eui64_to_iid XORs 0x02 (ipv6_addr.c:162 memmove+XOR); LICHEN link-locals embed the U/L-CLEARED canonical pubkey IID (identity_addr.c:43, lichen_link_rx.c:162-184 wire-EUI64 is U/L-SET, flipped once on address formation), so coap_server.c:651-652 produces sender_iid with bit 0x02 SET while main.c:189 root_iid has it CLEARED -> tunnel_auth.c:343 memcmp always fails -> WRONG_ROOT on every authentic grant; egress table stays empty -> forwarding.c decapsulate denies everything (fail-closed). Fix direction agreed: the FLIP is the bug, not the binding - the OSCORE ctx store is keyed by wire-EUI64 space, but receive() compares in canonical pubkey-IID space (kid check at :345 also needs canonical, since the COSE kid is encoded from canonical root_iid). Remove the flip at coap_server.c:652; do NOT flip root_iid in main.c (would break the kid compare).
